title: An item carries typed external tracker ids that backlog.json validates, commits and merge requests carry, and brief and find print
goal: An item has an external field, a map of tracker name to id list (such as jira to PROJ-123, or gitlab to an issue number), written by new and set --external TRACKER=ID (--add-external appends) and never by hand; backlog.json's trackers key names each tracker's id pattern and url template, check refuses an id that matches its tracker's pattern in no way or a tracker the file does not name, and a project without a trackers key accepts none; show prints them with their urls, through one helper that ST-nq5z6whn's brief calls (brief does not exist before it); the commits claim and done make carry one KB-Ref: <id> trailer per id (a form a tracker's smart-commit parser reads), check-trailers accepts it, and land writes the ids and urls into the merge request description; find matches an id as it matches a word of the title. The kb's own backlog.json names no tracker, so nothing changes for the kb's items.

gates.question: What shape does backlog.json's trackers key take: how does it name each tracker's id pattern, url template and trailer form?
options: object keyed by tracker name, each {pattern, url, ref}: pattern a regex the whole id matches, url a template with {id}, ref an optional template with {id} for the KB-Ref trailer value (default {id})
object keyed by tracker name, each {pattern, url} only: the KB-Ref trailer value is always the id as stored
gates.recommendation: object keyed by tracker name, each {pattern, url, ref}: pattern a regex the whole id matches, url a template with {id}, ref an optional template with {id} for the KB-Ref trailer value (default {id})
gates.answer: object keyed by tracker name, each {pattern, url, ref}: pattern a regex the whole id matches, url a template with {id}, ref an optional template with {id} for the KB-Ref trailer value (default {id})

gates.question: Where does the one helper that turns an item's external ids into references, urls and printed lines live, which show, the commit trailers, land and ST-nq5z6whn's brief call?
options: bl_base.py, beside the settings it reads and commit_written, which every bl_ module imports
a new bl_external.py that bl_base cannot import at load
gates.recommendation: bl_base.py, beside the settings it reads and commit_written, which every bl_ module imports
gates.answer: bl_base.py, beside the settings it reads and commit_written, which every bl_ module imports

gates.question: How does land put the ids and urls into the merge request description, since the push options that open the request are built in kg_sync.py, outside this item's touches?
options: after sync --push opened the code/ branch request, land finds it and sets its description through glab api (a failed call is said, never a failed land)
a merge_request.description push option built in kg_sync.py, which needs the touches widened
gates.recommendation: after sync --push opened the code/ branch request, land finds it and sets its description through glab api (a failed call is said, never a failed land)
gates.answer: after sync --push opened the code/ branch request, land finds it and sets its description through glab api (a failed call is said, never a failed land)

gates.question: What does the merge request description say of the external ids, given that GitLab closes the issues a closing keyword names and Jira closes an issue from a trigger word plus its key?
options: a block headed 'Tracker references (KB-Ref):' with one line per id of the form '- TRACKER REF: URL', no closing or trigger keyword, replacing an earlier block of land's own
one 'Related to REF' line per id
gates.recommendation: a block headed 'Tracker references (KB-Ref):' with one line per id of the form '- TRACKER REF: URL', no closing or trigger keyword, replacing an earlier block of land's own
gates.answer: a block headed 'Tracker references (KB-Ref):' with one line per id of the form '- TRACKER REF: URL', no closing or trigger keyword, replacing an earlier block of land's own

gates.question: How does check word a refusal of an external id?
options: one error per id naming the item, the tracker, the id and the tracker's pattern; for a tracker the file does not name, the trackers it does name (or that backlog.json names none)
one generic error per item: external ids invalid
gates.recommendation: one error per id naming the item, the tracker, the id and the tracker's pattern; for a tracker the file does not name, the trackers it does name (or that backlog.json names none)
